title: Single-Port RAM
statement: Implement a single-port RAM with 16 entries of 8-bit width. Writes should occur on the rising edge when wr_en is asserted, and reads should output the current value at addr. A synchronous reset should clear all memory entries.
module_signature: module single_port_ram_16x8(input clk, input rst, input wr_en, input [3:0] addr, input [7:0] din, output reg [7:0] dout);
behavior: Writes update memory on the clock edge when wr_en is 1.
dout reflects the current contents at addr.
rst clears all memory to 0 synchronously.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not use vendor-specific memory primitives.
example:
addr wr_en din | dout
0000 0 xx | stored
0001 1 10101010 | 10101010
hint: Use a reg array and clocked write logic.
